messages.author: swarm
messages.text:
BL-875 — DEFECT — a stray tracked package-lock.json at the repo root (no package.json beside it) turns any accidental root `npm install` into an unexplained one-line diff that rides along in the next commit
What it solves: - Verified unreferenced before proposing removal; the only consumer of a
  path by that name is build_freshness_lib.bb, and it names the
  `extension/` copy explicitly.
Approval context: Small slice, one call to sign off. The obvious fix — delete the file — is NOT sufficient on its own: npm recreates a lockfile when none exists, so deleting alone converts a tracked-diff trap into an untracked-stray trap. This ticket therefore pairs the deletion with a root-anchored .gitignore entry…
BL-875 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-875" (or "reject BL-875 <reason>") to act.
